profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer I at Black Duck
profile.summary:
SUMMARY
I’m a Principle Software Engineer with a Masters in Software Engineering with experience in Internet Security; 16+ years experienced in all phases of the SDLC using both traditional Waterfall and Agile/Scrum methods. I am a self-starter whose strengths include creative technical problem solving, improving process efficiency, and facilitating communication between multiple groups.  Applying these skills to my assignments has helped shorten many overall project cycles with stronger, quality centric products.

OS:  Windows Server 2008, 2010, Windows 7, Red Hat Linux 6.4, Apple iOS
 
Software Applications:  Aspect Unified IP 7.2, VMWare ESX 3.5, VMware vSphere , Microsoft HyperV, Microsoft ISA, QuickTest Professional 8.01, 10.0, AutoIt, Device Anywhere, Keon Certificate Authority, RSA Authentication Manager 6.1, 7.1, SecurID2.2 for iOS, Andriod, BlackBerry, Windows Phone, Symbian, IE, FireFox and Windows OS, BlackBerry Enterprise Server 4.1.x, 5.0, 

Software Tools and Processes:  Software Security Process, Digital Certificates, Ethernet Sniffers, Virtual LAN Areas, OSPF, CMISE coding, Optical Path Budgeting

Programming Languages: Java, Javascript, JQuery, C#, C/C++, SQL, DHTML

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I
positions.description:
An invaluable member of the Synopsys QA organization responsible for all Blackduck Hub releases.  The resident subject matter expert on SSO, SSL, Cloud Services, Docker container infrastructure, Proxies and performance / load testing.  Mentoring all new QA team members in building QA methodologies. Flexibility in supporting escalated customer issues with various Synopsys organizations that interact with Blackduck products including Support Engineering, Performance Labs and Solutions Teams.

- Expanded our test coverage to include third party SSO applications such as Okta, Google's G-Suite infrastructure and Microsoft Azure Single Sign on Service.  Engaged our IT department to install the necessary API plugins to integrate these services with our internal network.  Currently the Administrator for all three services.

- Designed and implemented test infrastructure to run our regression test suite against Cloud Services such as AWS, GCP and MS Azure.  Currently building a robust and automated framework utilizing each of the services API calls for our CI Pipeline.

- Designed and implemented a Performance test suite to exercise the Blackduck application under heavy load and at scale.  Measured and tracked the throughput of the SUT via REST API calls and DB queries against all versions of Blackduck to verify that we are scaling correctly.  Synopsys has created a Performance Lab team to take this on.

- I am currently expanding our Docker testing effort to include Kubernetes platforms such as Helm and OpenShift, ensuring that these platforms will be accessible to other Synopsys groups.

positions.title: Senior Quality Engineer
positions.description: An Automation Engineer for core products

positions.title: Principle Engineer (Automation)
positions.description:
A multi-present Software Engineer tasked with strengthening the product as well as the collaboration between multiple groups.  As a part of the Development Team, I help develop specialized Unit tests that exercises internal core functionality. As a part of the Quality Engineering Team, I've designed new 'High Availability' Regression test cases and developing/executing 'HA' Functional tests based on new architecture.  As part of the Automation Team I am creating verification tools in C# (DLL/Executables) to be used in fully automated 'End-to-End' tests which can also be used as stand-alone functional/debugging tools.

- Currently working in a multi-realm environment to test new prototypes of UIP clients using Claims Based authentication using Microsoft ADFS.  This is to be used across multiple Domains and Cloud environments such that customers Active Directories information and data does not need to be replicated or transferred.  We build ‘Trusts’ between the Customer deployed ADFS and the UIP ADFS so that neither deployed AD is exposed. 

- Focused functional, performance and reliability testing surrounding the 'High Availability' of critical processes necessary in the product.  Build and maintained High Availability Virtual test system to execute tests upon. 

- Developed tools in C#: Stop, Start, Restart and Monitor of remote processes using Impersonation.  Log Search tool using pattern matching to locate log statements on remote system logs based on a set of variable time-stamps.  Integrated these tools into Automated test infrastructure.

- Raised the knowledge base of multiple groups by publishing cross-pollinated 'How-To' documents, which included simplified installation instructions (where applicable), 'use of' the feature and the all-important Troubleshooting guide.

company.name: RSA The Security Division of EMC

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for Functional Testing, System Testing, Security Testing and Deployment Issues for multiple Mobile platforms, Windows and Macintosh Internet Browsers and Desktops.
- Designed and built Front End GUI Interfaces/Unit Tests (J2ME, C#) to drive and test SecurID Mobile API’s on mobile handsets 
- Defined and currently implementing Mobile Automation project.  Created Java application to drive Device Anywhere SDK in automating the interaction with physical Mobile Devices (BlackBerry, iPhone, Android).  Overall project to programmatically drive interaction with RSA Authentication Manager SDK, Microsoft Exchange APIs, Device Anywhere and other applications using Java.  This project will reduce all Mobile Testing by ~60% (projected)
- Designed and build a simulated customer infrastructure for the purpose of secure Software Token deployment across multiple Mobile platforms. I installed and configured Microsoft ISA in a dual homed configuration with a self-signed Certificate for internal authentication and a third party Certificate for external authentication with mobile devices.
- Mentoring Quality Engineers in becoming Project Leads, guiding them through Software Engineering Best Practices.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer II
positions.description:
Responsible for Manual Functional Testing, System Testing, Security Testing and Deployment Issues for multiple Mobile platforms, Windows and Macintosh Internet Browsers and Desktops.
- Comprised of Quality Engineers with experience in API testing (C & Java), GUI automation utilizing WinRunner, manual functional and system testing.
- Tested SecurID application for BlackBerry, iPhone, J2ME, Windows Mobile, Symbian &UIQ, Palm, Internet Explorer, FireFox, and Macintosh Safari.  Managed small groups for the various testing efforts.
- Created and presented 3 Power Point presentations for Development, QE and Customer Support: showing installation and use for CTKIP-SAE integration test bed, SecurID 2.2 for J2ME, BlackBerry Enterprise Server Mobile Data Solution.
- “Quallapalooza”, “Quallapalooza 2”, Prepared, managed and tracked test execution for several engineers for the span of two days.  Greatly reduced testing cycle, while provided teaching mechanism for those unfamiliar with the project.
- Provided Cost Analysis document for Director on using Third Party “Device Anywhere” as part of Automated testing of Mobile Devices.  
- Performed Document review for Admin Guides, User Guides, Test Plans, Configuration Matrices, Software Specification Documents, and Software Requirements Documents.
- Maintained Regression Test Suite for multiple mobile platforms.  Created new multifunctional Test Cases for all new SecurID software revisions.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for analyzing and assessing custom database application 'eSearch'; testing of custom Oracle Account Receivable models.
	Design, run and maintain manual test scripts in Mercury Quality Center on all new functionality for projects eSearch 2.7 and eSearch 3.0.
	Supervise overall functional and regression testing for eSearch 3.0.  Enter all issues into Merant Tracker, provide weekly reports to managers, supervisors and project leads via Mercury Quality Center on Status of testing.
	Lead a coordinated test effort with UK eSearch Development Team and US SafeKeeper Plus Development and Quality Assurance Teams.  Design Manual tests verifying the throughput between the modern database application eSearch and the legacy database application SafeKeeper Plus.
	Consolidate 750 old manual eSearch test scripts down to ~100 functional regression tests; This increased code coverage 70% and decreased man hours testing by 80%.  This resulted in a stronger, more secure application within a shorter project cycle.
	Run and maintain automated test scripts in WinRunner for Oracle Account Receivables. Work closely with in-house Oracle Development Team to test Iron Mountain customizations.  Enter all issues in Lotus Notes Tracker.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff I
positions.description:
Responsible for software quality assurance testing and integration of front-end customer client/server to Tellabs 7100 optical transport system.
Collaborated with software development team in design, development and integration of new features for Tellabs 7100 optical transport system ensuring that all feature requirements were met.  Developed and implemented tests in accordance with procedures for code development and procedures for project cycles. Identified problem areas quickly and offered ideas for code implementation.
Designed and implemented creative scripted tests (via. Visual Slick Edit) in Tcl/Expect on UNIX and WinRunner on Windows 2000.  Used these tests to verify feature functionality, which improved overall robustness and long term stability of Tellabs 7100 optical transport system.
Executed multiple manual and automatic tests in Tcl/Expect on UNIX and WinRunner on Windows 2000 to verify feature functionality.  Reported results quickly to development team and management to shorten project cycle.
Created high level training document for the installation and use of the front-end client/server element management interface on Windows NT and Windows 2000.
Applied common practices and engineering theories in completing technical assignments.
Defined test criteria and procedures in line with feature requirements at design and document review meetings.
Reported problem areas in code to software development team and developed patches and work arounds.
